thread:
Ivy: quick eyeball from QA: sampler in compact latency card is hard to tap on phones and overlaps the p95 handle. also legend doesn't indicate sample rate so heatmap feels misleading.
Noah: thanks. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/placeholder/compact-sampler-a11y. touch target ~26px.
Ivy: proposal: keep visual 24px but expand interactive hit to 44px (invisible padding). add a tiny legend chip like "10% sampled".
Kei: dev note: use `::before` centered hit area to avoid layout shift. ensure overlay floats (z-index) instead of pushing chart. sample CSS: `.sampler{width:24px;height:24px;position:relative}.sampler::before{content:"";position:absolute;left:50%;top:50%;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);width:44px;height:44px;border-radius:50%;}`
Sam: copy: change tooltip from "Sampling" to full "Sampling: Adaptive — balances latency and fidelity" and compact "Sampling: Adaptive". chip: "10% sampled" or shorthand "1/10". will draft short i18n-safe variants.
Noah: a11y: add `role=\"button\" aria-pressed=\"false\" aria-label=\"Sampling: Adaptive, 10% sampled\"`. announce mode changes via polite live region. include keyboard focus ring with contrast >=3:1.
Ivy: UX nit: when time range changes the sampler briefly disappears. keep it visible and show a small status toast: "Sampling preserved 10% sampled" (role/status) so screen readers hear it but focus isn't stolen.
Kei: agree. will prototype the hit area + focus ring PR and coordinate on z-index.
Sam: will post copy + length table by EOD.
Ivy: action items: 1) add 44px hit area (Kei) 2) aria + focus ring + live region (Noah) 3) copy + i18n notes (Sam) 4) legend sampled chip + toast (Ivy).
DesignBot: scheduled visual+accessibility sign-off 2026-04-20 11:00 PT.
Ivy: thanks all  closing thread, reopen if blockers.
_meta: Slack thread: compact sampler tap target, legend sampled chip, tooltip copy, aria, focus ring, toast status for latency/throughput observability UI.
